general_information.Description: The course is to provide students with practical knowledge in ES field: 1. Introduction of Embedded System 2. Using circuit design and simulation softwares 3. Programming Essentials 4. uC hardware 5. Digital I/O interface 6. Timer and Interrupt 7. Compare and capture 8. Analog Interface 9. Power outputs 10. Serial communication 11. Sensor interfacing 12. Practicing with PICkit2 of Microchip 13. Analyzing some practical projects This course will comprehensively guide to interfacing microcontrollers based on the I/O devices of the PIC 16F877 chip, including keypads, displays, analogue, timers and a full range of serial peripherals. Each interface is explained in detail by means of fully operational, interactive demonstration application using Proteus VSM design and simulation. Each demo application can be viewed by chapter – schematic, design file, source code and operational description Assessment scheme: 1) On-going asessment: 60% - 02 Assignments: 2x15%=30% - 01 quiz: 20% - Lab activities: 10% 2) Final Exam: 40% 3) Final Result: 100% Completion Criteria: 1) Every on-going assessment component >0 2) Final Exam Score >=4 & Final Result >=5
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination. '- Student is responsible to do all exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time. - Constantly follow announcements on intranet/CMS at http://cms.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information.
general_information.Tools: Technical facility: - 8 PICkit 2 (RP BOOK1) were supported by Microchip's presentation at Vietnam. - The necessary electronic components: + 8 Programmer ICD2, 650 000 VND/1 Programmmer, http://www.ic-vn.com/modules.php?name=Products&op=viewproduct&cid=31 + 8 blank boards for experiments, 100 000 VDN/1 board + 8 LCD, 60 000 VND/1LCD + 8 ISP cable, 10 000 VND/1ISP cable + 8 PIC16F877A, 70 000 VND/1PIC + 8 Max232, 15 000 VND/1Max232 + 8 Crystals, 15 000 VND/1 Crystal + 8 x 5V power, 25 000 VND/1ps + 8 USB cable, 15 000 VND/1cable + 8 RS232 cable, 20 000 VND/1cable + Other components: resistor, capacitor, small electricwire... - Trival softwares for design, simulation and student version IDE will be used in this course.
